Subject: Draft itineraries + resilience playbook for Acme exec workshop (June 8)

Hi Avery / Marissa,

Attached are the draft itineraries for the Acme executive workshop (June 8–9) and a short resilience playbook I recommend we follow for travel-day contingencies. Notes up front:

- Blocked seats confirmed for 12 travelers; 3 itineraries are on mixed carriers (see PNR summary).
- Two critical items: Patrick Lee (Acme) has a single-seat downgrade on his return (waitlist), and one connecting itinerary has a < 45 min connection at SFO.
- Proposed mitigations: pre-reserve standby on the earlier redeye, confirm an on-call car at SFO, and hold a small hotel buffer block in SF for late arrivals.

What I attached: itineraries_v3.pdf (per-person itinerary), pnr_summary.csv (PNR and booking refs).

Two asks for you both:
1) Approve the standby/resilience line items so we can ticket alternates today.
2) Confirm whether we should proactively rebook the SFO connector to a later flight (adds ~1.5h travel time but avoids risk).

Operational playbook (short):
- If connection risk > 30% (based on historical delay), switch to next available non-connecting flight and log original PNR.
- If Patrick remains waitlisted after 24 hours, move him to standby on UA 271 (redeye) and confirm hotel-night contingency.
- On-site handoff: assign a single on-call lead with full access to PNRs + crew phone.

I can make the rebookings immediately once you give the green light.

Thanks,
Helen Park
Senior Account Manager | Summit Logistics
helen@summitlogistics.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments:
- itineraries_v3.pdf (PDF, 12 pages)
- pnr_summary.csv (CSV, 1 page)

Subject: Re: Draft itineraries + resilience playbook for Acme exec workshop (June 8)

Thanks Helen — useful framing. Quick responses inline.

- Approve standby/resilience items. Please ticket alternates for everyone where available.
- For the SFO connector: please rebook those two travelers (Ops lead + engineer) to the non-connecting option. We can absorb the extra 1.5h; avoiding a missed-connection escalation is worth it.
- Patrick Lee: keep him on the waitlist for now but open standby on UA 271 as you suggested. If confirmed before EOD tomorrow, great; otherwise we'll move to standby and book a contingency room.

Logistics asks for handoff:
- On-site lead will be Marissa. Marissa, can you confirm you have mobile access to the PNR CSV and that travel_ops@acmecorp.com can share OTPs/PNR codes with you?
- Vivek: can you own the on-call car arrangement for arrivals between 10pm–2am? If yes, I'll include that in the handoff checklist.

If Helen can push the rebookings now, we'll follow up with a short SMS plan to the execs this afternoon.

Avery
